rootCause: Catalog boards with architecture classes not covered by semantic rules fell through to index-modulo topology selection. Incomplete or mismatched topology data could then reach downstream array operations and fail as an opaque undefined .map error; Board007 fieldbus also selected a USB-PD topology instead of a CAN-capable controller.
fixSummary: Validate catalog input and production BOM structure at the adapter boundary, and map fieldbus/CAN/industrial control architectures to the STM32 CAN production topology before any index fallback.
regressions: CAN/fieldbus catalog boards select the CAN-capable STM32 production topology
catalog definition rejects missing board input with an actionable contract error
never: Allow an incomplete topology record to reach downstream map operations
Use board index as the primary electrical architecture selector
